_source: The hub's own answers, captured by tests/integration/test_desk_workbenches.py (TestClient, isolated database). HOLDSPEAK_WIRE_WRITE=1 rewrites this file; never hand-edit it.

templates.name: Friday team update
templates.description: Drafts your team update from this week's meetings and notes.
templates.instruction: Draft my team update for this week: what shipped, what slipped, and what I need from each person. Name the meeting or note each point comes from.

templates.name: Meeting follow-ups
templates.description: Lists the decisions and follow-ups of a meeting, with owners and dates.
templates.instruction: List the decisions and the follow-ups from this meeting. Give each follow-up an owner and a date when the meeting names them.

templates.name: 1:1 prep
templates.description: Prepares your 1:1s: open commitments, the last 1:1, what to raise.
templates.instruction: For each person: their open commitments, what we said in our last 1:1, and what I should raise this week.

templates.name: Summarize a drawer
templates.description: Summarizes what is new in a drawer.
templates.instruction: Summarize what is new in these notes. Start with what needs me.
